text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp starts today, and it's time for Narita Taishin to focus on improving her skills ahead of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her social battery is running emptier than usual since being at camp forces her into closer quarters with others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to find a quiet spot to help ease her nerves and allow her to train at her own pace.
